verdict: NO TRANSITION IN THE CLEAN CONSTRUCTION: surviving damage never drops below 0.594 across T in [0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.35, 0.5], down to T=0.02 where sampling is essentially deterministic. There is no frozen phase and therefore no absorbing-state transition. This is the pre-registered good null: the AR frozen phase existed because the lattice had an absorbing state (every site resampling to a single token), F66 found no such state here, and this confirms the dynamical consequence. The transition the universality programme measured was only ever the out-of-distribution artifact. M2 and M3 are moot; claim A in paper/plan_paper2.md strengthens.
